toilet-porta-cabins.fullTechnicalDescription: Toilet Porta Cabins is a factory-fabricated MS corrugated container-style cabin prepared on the 20x10x8.5 ft costing reference size (200 sq.ft.). It uses 125×75×4 mm protected MS C-channel as the main chassis, 1.2–1.6 mm corrugated MS sheet for the external walls and 1.4–1.6 mm corrugated MS sheet for the sloped roof. The interior uses 10–12 mm fibre-cement board with ceramic tiles or FRP finish in wet zones, with 50 mm mineral wool where required in the walls and 75 mm glass/mineral wool below the roof. The floor combines 18–24 mm cement board with waterproof membrane with 2.5–3 mm anti-skid safety vinyl, ceramic tile or FRP grating. Multi-seat sanitary cabin with waterproof lining, drainage and exhaust. Multi-seat sanitary fixture quantities distinguish this toilet-only page.
